<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Crossy Road Clone - Three.js</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; background-color: #87CEEB; } /* Sky blue background */
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://unpkg.com/three@0.156.0/build/three.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        // --- Global Variables ---
        let scene, camera, renderer;
        let player;
        let roadSegments = []; // Array to hold all road segment meshes
        let backgroundObjects = []; // Array to hold all background meshes
        const clock = new THREE.Clock();

        // --- Initialization Function ---
        function init() {
            // 1. Scene Setup
            scene = new THREE.Scene();
            scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB); // Sky color

            // 2. Camera Setup (Perspective Camera is best for a 3D game)
            camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
            camera.position.set(0, 5, 10); // Slightly elevated view
            camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

            // 3. Renderer Setup
            renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
            renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true; // Enable shadows for 'ultra details'
            document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

            // 4. Lighting (Crucial for visible geometry and shadows)
            const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x666666); // Soft ambient light
            scene.add(ambientLight);

            const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
            directionalLight.position.set(10, 20, 10);
            directionalLight.castShadow = true;
            // Improve shadow quality
            directionalLight.shadow.mapSize.width = 2048;
            directionalLight.shadow.mapSize.height = 2048;
            directionalLight.shadow.camera.near = 0.5;
            directionalLight.shadow.camera.far = 50;
            scene.add(directionalLight);

            // 5. Create Ground Plane (The underlying surface)
            const groundGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 50);
            const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: 0x6B8E23 }); // Olive green grass/dirt
            const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeometry, groundMaterial);
            ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2; // Lay flat
            ground.receiveShadow = true;
            scene.add(ground);

            // 6. Implement Geometry Components
            createBackgroundScenery(); // NEW: Building/Scenery placement
            createRoadLanes(); // UPDATED: Procedural road generation

            // 7. Player Character (Simple representation for now)
            const playerGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 16, 16);
            const playerMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 });
            player = new THREE.Mesh(playerGeometry, playerMaterial);
            player.position.set(0, 1, -10); // Start at the back, slightly above ground
            player.castShadow = true;
            scene.add(player);

            // 8. Event Listeners
            window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);
            document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown, false);
        }

        // Function to generate background buildings and scenery
        function createBackgroundScenery() {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 5, 1); // Template geometry for buildings
            const colors = [0xA0522D, 0x8B4513, 0x556B2F, 0x696969]; // Different brown/gray colors
            const count = 40; // Number of structures to create

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const randomColor = Math.random() * 0xFFFFFF;
                const material = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: randomColor });
                
                // Randomize size and offset
                const sizeX = Math.random() * 6 + 3;
                const sizeY = Math.random() * 8 + 2;
                const sizeZ = Math.random() * 10 + 5;

                const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(
                    new THREE.BoxGeometry(sizeX, sizeY, sizeZ), 
                    material
                );

                // Random placement along the left and right sides (X-axis)
                const side = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2); // 0 for Left, 1 for Right
                const sideOffset = side === 0 ? -20 : 20;

                // Random placement along the depth (Z-axis)
                // Place them far enough back but not too far (between -50 and -150)
                const zPos = Math.random() * 100 - 150;
                
                // Random slight elevation
                mesh.position.set(sideOffset + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 5, sizeY / 2, zPos);
                
                mesh.castShadow = true;
                mesh.receiveShadow = true;
                scene.add(mesh);
                backgroundObjects.push(mesh);
            }
        }

        // Function to generate road lanes (Procedural Logic Implemented Here)
        function createRoadLanes() {
            const laneWidth = 45; 
            const segmentLength = 20;
            const segmentMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: 0x808080 }); // Grey asphalt color

            // Start at Z = -10 (near player) and proceed backwards to Z = -160 (far)
            let currentZ = -10;
            const startZ = -10;
            const endZ = -160;
            const stepDistance = 15; // General step distance between major elements

            // Type 1: Crosswalk (Green/Yellow visual cue)
            const crosswalkMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: 0x4CAF50 }); 
            // Type 0: Solid Road (Grey)
            const roadMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: 0x808080 }); 

            while (currentZ > endZ) {
                let zPos = currentZ;
                let mesh;
                let type;

                // Determine type: Crosswalk (1) if Z is near the start/end, or if random check passes.
                // Simple procedural pattern: Crosswalk, Road, Crosswalk, Road...
                if (Math.floor((startZ - zPos) / stepDistance) % 2 === 0) {
                    type = 1; // Crosswalk (Passable/Distinct)
                    const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(laneWidth, 0.1, segmentLength);
                    mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, crosswalkMaterial);
                    mesh.receiveShadow = true;
                } else {
                    type = 0; // Solid Road (Barriers/Neutral)
                    const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(laneWidth, 0.1, segmentLength);
                    mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, roadMaterial);
                    mesh.receiveShadow = true;
                }
                
                // Position the segment
                mesh.position.set(0, 0.05, zPos);
                scene.add(mesh);
                roadSegments.push(mesh);

                // Move to the next general location
                currentZ -= stepDistance;
                
                // Add a secondary, random obstacle (e.g., small barrier) every few segments
                if (Math.random() > 0.8 && currentZ > -100) {
                    const barrierLength = 2 + Math.random() * 3;
                    const barrierWidth = 3 + Math.random() * 4;
                    const barrierHeight = 0.2;
                    const barrierGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(barrierWidth, barrierHeight, barrierLength);
                    const barrierMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({ color: 0x555555 });
                    const barrier = new THREE.Mesh(barrierGeometry, barrierMaterial);

                    // Random X placement and Z progression
                    barrier.position.set((Math.random() - 0.5) * 15, 0.1, currentZ);
                    barrier.castShadow = true;
                    barrier.receiveShadow = true;
                    scene.add(barrier);
                    // Note: We don't store these small barriers in roadSegments array, 
                    // but they function as part of the environment geometry.
                }
            }
        }

        // --- Event Handlers ---

        function onWindowResize() {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        }

        // Simple key handling for basic movement simulation
        const moveSpeed = 0.15;
        const direction = { x: 0, z: 0 };
        function onKeyDown(event) {
            switch (event.key) {
                case 'ArrowUp':
                case 'w':
                    direction.z = -1;
                    break;
                case 'ArrowDown':
                case 's':
                    direction.z = 1;
                    break;
                case 'ArrowLeft':
                case 'a':
                    direction.x = -1;
                    break;
                case 'ArrowRight':
                case 'd':
                    direction.x = 1;
                    break;
                default:
                    direction.x = 0;
                    direction.z = 0;
                    return;
            }
            // Prevent continuous movement until key is released (for simple state machine)
        }

        // Need to handle key release to stop movement
        document.addEventListener('keyup', function(event) {
            switch (event.key) {
                case 'ArrowUp':
                case 'w':
                case 'ArrowDown':
                case 's':
                case 'ArrowLeft':
                case 'a':
                case 'ArrowRight':
                case 'd':
                    // Only reset if the released key was the primary direction
                    if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 'w' || event.key === 'ArrowUp') {
                        if (direction.z > 0) direction.z = 0;
                    } else if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 's' || event.key === 'ArrowDown') {
                        if (direction.z < 0) direction.z = 0;
                    } else if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 'a' || event.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
                        if (direction.x < 0) direction.x = 0;
                    } else if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 'd' || event.key === 'ArrowRight') {
                        if (direction.x > 0) direction.x = 0;
                    }
            }
        });


        // --- Animation Loop ---
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);

            const delta = clock.getDelta();

            // Player Movement Logic
            if (direction.x !== 0 || direction.z !== 0) {
                player.position.x += direction.x * moveSpeed * delta * 60;
                player.position.z += direction.z * moveSpeed * delta * 60;
                
                // Simple boundary check for demonstration purposes
                player.position.x = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(player.position.x, -45, 45);
                player.position.z = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(player.position.z, -45, 45);
            }

            // Keep camera slightly following the player's Z position (Simulating the crossy movement)
            camera.position.z = player.position.z + 10;
            camera.lookAt(player.position.x, player.position.y, player.position.z);


            // Render the scene
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        // Start the game
        init();
        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
